summary: All three quality gates pass (typecheck, lint, 707 tests). Wrote 26 new tests for useMatchmakingQueue hook covering: join flow (waiting -> polling -> matched), instant match, 409 resume, 429 rate limit, timeout on expired/idle, network error, cancel with DELETE, unmount cleanup, reset from terminal states, poll error swallowing, non-ok poll response handling, boundary cases (matched without duelId on both POST and poll), haptics, and JSON parse failure fallback. Added jsdom as dev dependency for React hook testing in the vitest jsdom environment.
goal: Verify 1v1 Quick Play feature: useMatchmakingQueue hook and HomeScreen QuickPlayCard/SearchingOverlay

join_waiting_poll_matched.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: transitions through joining -> searching -> matched when polled

join_instant_match.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: goes directly to matched when POST returns matched with duelId

join_409_resume.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: resumes polling when POST returns 409 (already in queue)

join_429_rate_limit.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: sets error state with message on 429 rate limit

timeout_expired.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: transitions to timeout when poll returns expired

timeout_idle.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: transitions to timeout when poll returns idle (queue slot gone)

timeout_post_expired.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: transitions to timeout when POST response says expired

network_error.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: sets network error when POST throws

cancel_stops_polling_sends_delete.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: stops polling and sends DELETE on cancel

cancel_idle_no_delete.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: does not send DELETE when cancelling from idle

unmount_cleanup_searching.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: clears interval and sends DELETE on unmount while searching

unmount_idle_no_delete.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: does not send DELETE on unmount when idle

unmount_matched_no_delete.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: does not send DELETE on unmount after matching

poll_continues_on_waiting.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: continues polling while status is waiting

poll_error_swallowed.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: swallows poll errors and retries on next interval

poll_nonok_ignored.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: ignores non-ok poll responses and keeps polling

json_parse_failure.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: handles non-ok POST response when JSON parsing fails

boundary_matched_no_duelid_poll.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: does not transition to matched when poll has matched status but no duelId

boundary_matched_no_duelid_post.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: does not transition to matched when POST has matched status but no duelId

server_error_message.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: displays server error message from response body

fallback_error_message.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: falls back to default error message when response has no error string

initial_idle_state.test: app/tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts: starts in idle with null duelId and errorMessage

learnings.insight: React hook tests in this repo require jsdom vitest environment. The `@vitest-environment jsdom` comment directive and `globalThis.IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true` are needed. A minimal renderHook using react-dom/client createRoot + React.act works without @testing-library/react.
learnings.action: Use the pattern from tests/hooks/useMatchmakingQueue.test.ts for future hook tests. jsdom is now installed as a devDependency.

learnings.insight: The hook correctly guards against 'matched' status without a duelId on both POST and poll paths, preventing navigation to /duel/undefined. Cleanup DELETE is only sent when inQueueRef.current is true, so no spurious DELETE on idle/matched unmounts.
learnings.action: No action needed -- boundary behavior is tested.

learnings.insight: 26 new tests added (681 -> 707 total). All 3 gates pass. 1 new dev dependency (jsdom 30.1.0). Test runtime: 8.01s (from 7.45s baseline, +0.56s for new jsdom-environment test file).
